# sql.js 1.14.2

Browser-only JavaScript and WebAssembly from the official npm package. The MIT license is included. SQLite is public domain.

- Source: https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/tree/v1.14.2
- Registry archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/sql.js/-/sql.js-1.14.2.tgz
- Archive integrity: sha512-3ZGPovObMFrdw79zrUHbfdE/DLIsy8jdNdssmMSQuRAymedU6q84asPt0kgiqrdMYlPegDItiIMfmIXzZnYFcw==

The JavaScript wrapper uses an ESM default export and a local CommonJS guard variable so the same bundle can load in a browser module service worker. The WebAssembly file is unchanged.
